faqs.a:
Section 5307.1 General
, is amended to read as follows:
"5307.1 General. Compressed gasses
in storage or use not regulated by this material-specific provisions of Chapters
                  6, 54, 55 and 60 through 67, including asphyxiant, irritant and radioactive gasses,
                  shall comply with this section in addition to other requirements of this chapter.
                  The provisions of this chapter shall apply to new or existing systems."
(Ord. No.
4739
, § 3, 9-14-2020)
